method: Inflation momentum plus a declared gasoline contribution adjustment; hidden market comparison
eligibility_rationale: September is incomplete and its BLS CPI release is scheduled for October14. Select the0.2% threshold without looking at odds. Require at most5-cent spread and at least10 contracts each side.
contract_match_rationale: Monthly all-items CPI-U seasonally adjusted, signed one-decimal change; strictly above0.2. Generic terms and market-specific shutdown/close rules retained. Calculation assumes ordinary release; fallback is not independently modeled.
